findings.claim: The just install and the starter path followed tests/test_starter.py at the root. The revised plan installs just in the kmctl job (whose directory, packages/kmctl/tests, now holds test_starter.py) and runs packages/kmctl/tests/test_starter.py -m integration in the starter job. O1's checked-by and eval row r1 pin both.

The aggregate tests job now ships in O1, which therefore can ship alone; O2 is support and needs O1. Eval row r2 pins the job's needs, if always(), failure unless every result succeeded, and no name on prek, knowledge or tests.
